name: Virtual'na peremoha
source:
'These were moments that cannot be forgotten. How many bright and pure hopes, how much desire to work! Reverend Nicodemus delivered an insightful speech. The choir shouted: 'many summers to our master, the Hetman of all Ukraine', the bells of Saint Sophia were ringing with all their might. I was outwardly calm, but in my heart I was going through a lot.'

Pavlo Skoropadskyi

Have you ever wondered what the course of events would have been if Pavlo Skoropadsky had not overthrown the Central Rada? And what would happen if the regime of the hetman himself would hold out later? Would Ukraine have gained independence 100 years earlier? How would our Motherland and the whole world in general change in this case? In this game, you can create your own virtual version of history and see what would happen next...

The game takes place at the end of April 1918, during the Hetman coup in Ukraine. The game does not pretend to be historically accurate, but it will be especially interesting for those who are interested in history!

[Translated from [url=https://slobidski-ihry.itch.io/virtualna-peremoha]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“那是令人永生难忘的时刻。多少光明而纯粹的希望，多少投身事业的热忱！尼科季姆主教发表了鞭辟入里的演说，唱诗班高呼：‘愿我们的主君、全乌克兰的盖特曼万寿无疆！’圣索菲亚大教堂的钟声震耳欲聋地鸣响。我表面上镇定自若，内心却早已波澜万丈。”

——帕夫洛·斯科罗帕茨基

你是否曾设想过，倘若当年帕夫洛·斯科罗帕茨基没有推翻中央拉达，历史进程将会走向何方？又或者，倘若盖特曼政权在此后得以稳固延续，又会发生怎样的变化？乌克兰是否会提前100年赢得独立？我们的祖国乃至整个世界又将随之呈现怎样一番面貌？在本作中，你将亲手谱写属于自己的架空历史，见证接下来可能发生的一切……

故事发生在1918年4月底乌克兰盖特曼政变期间。本作并不标榜严谨的历史考据，但对于喜爱历史的玩家而言定会格外引人入胜！
